newsitem.title: USA: Eaton Corp to open new operation in China.
newsitem.headline: Eaton Corp to open new operation in China.

text.p: Eaton Corp, a global manufacturer of engineered products, said on Monday that it had gained Chinese government approval to begin manufacturing heavy-duty truck transmissions in Shanghai.

In a statement, Eaton said it will open a new, 100,000-square-foot facility in the city to house its Eaton Truck and Bus Components Co Ltd, which will will manufacture 10, 13 and 18-speed transmissions for manufacturers in Australia, China, Japan, South Korea and other Asia-Pacific countries.
Production is expected to begin by early next year and is projected to grow to more than 24,000 units annually by 2008, the company said.
ETB-Shanghai is the company's fourth operation in China, it added.
